engines_supported: other (covers: lzdoom, vkdoom, eternity, doomsday, edge-classic, custom)
storage: SQLite (modernc.org/sqlite v1.57.0, pure Go, CGO_ENABLED=0) via database/sql; InitDB in internal/database/db.go enforces PRAGMAs: foreign_keys=ON, journal_mode=WAL, busy_timeout=5000, synchronous=NORMAL; connection pool 10 (1 for :memory: to preserve state). SchemaSQL in internal/database/schema.go defines tables: engines(id PK, name, executable, version, family, created_at, updated_at), iwads(id PK, path UNIQUE, name, type, lump_count, size, sha256, created_at/upd), mods(id PK, path UNIQUE, name, format, category, size, modified_at, sha256, lump_count, structures JSON[], is_favorite, created_at/upd), profiles(id PK, name, description, engine_id FK SET NULL, iwad_id FK SET NULL, parent_profile_id FK SET NULL, isolate_saves, arguments JSON[], working_dir, is_favorite, created_at/upd), profile_mods(id PK, profile_id FK CASCADE, mod_id FK CASCADE, enabled, sort_order), launch_history(id PK, profile_id, profile_name, engine_name, iwad_name, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, exit_code, status, command_line), settings(key PK, value TEXT JSON). Indexes: idx_mods_name/path/format/category/favorite, idx_profile_mods_profile_order/mod, idx_launch_history_started/profile. Repositories in internal/database/repositories.go (engineRepo, iwadRepo, modRepo with List search LIKE wildcards, ToggleFavorite, GetUsageCounts; profileRepo Create/Update transactional + SetProfileMods reorder; historyRepo GetStats aggregates; settingsRepo JSON marshal). Migrations: backward-compat ALTER ADD isolate_saves, parent_profile_id. Data flow: frontend Wails RPC (frontend/src/lib/api.ts callBackend -> window.go.main.App binding or mock fallback) -> app.go App struct DI (database + 8 services + idgames) -> domain models (internal/domain/models.go) -> repositories -> SQLite WAL file at os.UserConfigDir/rnt-launcher/rnt-launcher.db (or temp :memory: for tests/e2e). Filesystem layer (internal/filesystem/wad.go, archive.go, inspector.go, hasher.go, palette.go) reads files read-only, no ownership assumption, streaming hashes, ZipSlip-guarded extraction. Process layer (internal/launcher) supervised via launcherService map + monitorProcess goroutine emitting launch:exit event via Wails runtime.EventsEmit -> frontend runtime.EventsOn (frontend/src/lib/events.ts). Diagnostics via PRAGMA integrity_check quick_check + orphan sweep.
known_gaps: File watcher NOT implemented — no inotify/ReadDirectoryChangesW continuous scan (deferred by design for CPU/battery; manual Scan Folders button or AutoScanOnStartup; docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md 1.3, PRD 15).

Single primary category per mod only — no multi-tagging or user custom tags (mods Category enum single value; deferred to v0.2.0 Organization milestone; docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md 1.2, COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS 1.2).
Linux Wayland drag-and-drop intermittently blocked by compositor/WebKitGTK policies (HTML5 drop events not emitted from Dolphin/Nautilus; workaround picker button; docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md 2.1).
macOS Gatekeeper quarantine (com.apple.quarantine xattr) blocks unsigned engine binaries until System Settings verification; validator reports permission warnings only (docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md 2.2).
Legacy source port PK3 incompatibility advisory only — blocking/warning before launch (SupportsPK3 true only for gzdoom/zandronum; no automatic conversion; docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md 3.1).
No automatic Steam/GOG IWAD discovery via libraryfolders.vdf / appmanifest acf parsing (DoomLauncher parity missing; COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS 2.1 Strengths, Tier 1 roadmap not yet implemented).

No demo/statdump interception (-statdump / -levelstat / .zds save header kill/secret/item tracking) — only generic duration/exitCode telemetry (DoomLauncher strength, COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS 2.1.3 vs launcher.go).
No dedicated savegame swapping DB with screenshot metadata — only per-profile isolated directories via -savedir (saves.SaveService; COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS Tier 1 "Isolated Savegame Management" partial).
No multiplayer master-server browser, server join configuration, or netplay GUI beyond dmflags/compatflags modals (PRD 11 Out-of-Scope, COMPETITOR_ANALYSIS RocketLauncher DoSbox vs RNT none).
No in-app marketplace beyond /idgames — no ModDB/scraper, no Doomworld README inline viewer beyond download+import (PRD 6.2/11 local-first, KNOWN_ISSUES 1.1 by design).
No DOSBox automated scripting for vanilla DOS executables (RocketLauncher differentiator; RNT only launches native source ports).
No profile templates gallery — only duplicate + empty create + YAML/ZDL import (PRD 78 Future Templates roadmap).

Cloud sync / multi-machine path portability limited to YAML v1 name/filename resolution — no path rewriting middleware for cross-OS absolute path translation beyond lower-cased filename match (profiles/yaml.go resolution heuristic).
No in-memory log rotation/file persistence — MemoryLogHandler bounded ring buffer only (logger/logger.go); logs lost after restart (by design).

Eternity/Doomsday/EDGE/KEX engine dialects not distinct — all route to GenericDialect (launcher/dialect.go GetDialect default); trait adaptation shallower than DoomRunner's deep EngineTraits for EDGE/KEX flags.
